English Prompt: A seamless single-take fly-through shot. Starting in a dimly lit vintage library, an ancient magic book on a wooden desk opens by itself, emitting glowing golden particles from its pages. The camera rapidly zooms into an illustration on the page, transitioning directly into the sky above a breathtaking fantasy mountain range. A translucent dragon made of starry nebula soars between floating islands and cascading waterfalls under a golden sunset. Epic scale, fluid particle effects, masterpiece composition.

2. 微距自然与流体细节（展现：毛发纹理、水滴张力、景深变化）

中文提示词：极度特写微距镜头，清晨的阳光穿过茂密的热带雨林，一滴晶莹剔透的露珠从翠绿的蕨类植物叶片尖端缓缓滑落，正好滴在一只色彩斑斓的微小树蛙背上。水滴撞击瞬间迸发出细小的水珠，树蛙眨了眨金色的大眼睛，身体纹理和皮肤上的水分清晰可见。浅景深，背景是梦幻的金色散景光斑，丁达尔效应，国家地理纪录片画质。

English Prompt: Extreme macro close-up shot. Morning sunlight filters through a lush tropical rainforest as a crystal-clear dewdrop slowly slides off the tip of a vibrant green fern leaf, landing gently on the back of a tiny, colorful tree frog. The impact creates microscopic water droplets in slow motion. The frog blinks its large golden eyes, showcasing intricate skin textures and moisture. Shallow depth of field, dreamy golden bokeh background, Tyndall effect, National Geographic documentary style.
